summary: PEG of 0.52 and forward P/E of 14.2x signal deep undervaluation, but revenue growth of just 2.9% and razor-thin operating margins (1.0%) raise quality concerns; 104% earnings growth is likely base-effect recovery (unverified). China ADR geopolitical risk and Beijing-influenced capital allocation (e.g., $2B gaming exit) warrant a discount. Quant composite 72/100 reflects strong value and momentum signals offset by tepid growth.
